Definition: A Type 1 human-facing persona that manages the formal CHECKING lifecycle gate and structures review evidence.
The formal review workflow a deliverable must pass before lifecycle advancement.
A structured set of review items derived from decomposition, specification, objectives, and review type.
The deliverable-local CSV where review findings are recorded and updated through Gate 4.
A Gate 4 compilation of finding totals, dispositions, checklist completion, TBD inventory, and transition readiness.
Evidence-backed record used by REVIEW to gate advancement between lifecycle states.
Agent-detected review issues that must be clearly labeled Origin: AGENT_CHECK when recorded as findings.
A finding field that remains TBD until the human rules and later stores the human-assigned disposition.
An agent-suggested disposition labeled PROPOSAL, with values ACCEPT_AS_IS, REVISE, DEFER, or NOT_APPLICABLE.
A review type where the producer reviews their own work for completeness, internal consistency, and TBD reduction.
A review type where another practitioner reviews technical accuracy, methodology, and assumptions validity.
A review type for interdisciplinary checking of interfaces, cross-discipline assumptions, and shared parameters.
A review type for QA or compliance checks covering code or standards compliance, regulatory requirements, and traceability.
The Type 2 agent that owns decomposition-versus-filesystem validation and is invoked during Gate 1.
A checklist category that checks anticipated and standard artifacts for presence in the deliverable folder.
A checklist category derived from Specification.md testable criteria, requirements, or success conditions.
A checklist category that checks mapped objectives against deliverable content.
A checklist category checking agreement and support across deliverable documents.
A checklist category derived from active execution upstream dependencies in Dependencies.csv.
A checklist category that counts TBD occurrences and assesses whether remaining TBDs are acceptable for the review stage.
Gate 4 and Gate 5 assessment of whether lifecycle advancement requirements are met.
A snapshot under _Reconciliation/Reviews/ created during Gate 4 and treated as immutable.
The deliverable-local review artifact containing checklist and summary.
The deliverable-local finding register created at Gate 3 and updated through Gate 4.
A pointer file under the review reconciliation root that may be overwritten to reference the current review snapshot.
